module: "Overview" window (fg_treeview) of the Flowgraph editor: tree of the project's graphs (and macros) with a text filter. The filter applies to the graph names, and to the node names if the flowgraph.debug.displayNodesInOverview preference is enabled. A context menu on a node offers Focus and Delete.
notes: Only graphs whose name (or a parent's) passes the filter are drawn; otherwise only the current graph (mgr.graph) remains displayed (skipDrawing).
In debug mode (flowgraph.debug.editorDebug), a "Print Graphs" button prints the structure of all graphs and macros to the console.
Drawing of the root macros is commented out in the code: only mgr.graphs are displayed in the tree.

init.desc: Creates the text filter and registers the window (150x300, hidden by default).

drawPopups.desc: Draws the "nodeOverviewPopup" popup: Focus (selects the node and navigates to it) and Delete (graph:deleteNode).

skipDrawing.desc: Indicates whether a graph must be hidden: false if it (or one of its parents) passes the filter, otherwise true except for the current graph.

returns.desc: true if the graph must be skipped.

drawGraph.desc: Draws a graph of the tree (and recursively its children).

fillPassedGraphsArray.desc: Fills self.passedGraphIds with the ids of the graphs and macros whose name (or a node, depending on the preference) passes the filter.

TreeView.desc: Draws the window content: filter, debug button, sorted list of root graphs.

draw.desc: Draws the window if it is visible (calls TreeView).

selectNode.desc: Selects a node in the editor (fge.SelectNode).
